summary: Verified the 3 reported mobile-view builder bug fixes plus desktop regression on /builder. All 3 bug fixes PASS: (1) family rail buttons are now colored with dark readable labels (EV rgb(240,176,74), LG rgb(111,207,190), AI rgb(242,169,203), AG rgb(182,156,232), ST rgb(130,216,164), CT rgb(228,226,216), DT white) all with text color rgb(10,15,22). All 13 rail buttons present and clickable; clicking rail-AG updates the mobile family header to 'AG Agents — Characters that live in your world.'. (2) Under ASK BOLT bar there is a single compact dropdown [data-testid=builder-ideas-dropdown] with placeholder 'try an idea' and real idea options. Selecting an option (vals[1]) correctly fills [data-testid=builder-sentence-input] with the idea text. No 'AI speaking' chips anywhere on the page. (3) Mobile palette strip shows [data-testid=blocky-family-head-mobile] with code square + name + description (e.g., 'DT Data — Lists, randomness and numbers.'), followed by 'DATA — CLICK TO ADD' and 15 visible palette blocks. Regression: clicking a visible mobile palette block adds a node to the canvas (blocky-node count 0->1). Desktop (1440x900) still renders 13 rail buttons + 31 palette entries + canvas with dark bg rgb(10,15,22); dropdown present. No horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth = 390). Ask Bolt compile flow not forced-exercised (compile is slow upstream and the dropdown onChange only sets sentence per the review note).

issues: Minor: data-testid=blocky-family-head-mobile is also rendered on the DESKTOP viewport (visible at the top-left of the palette column at 1440px). It behaves correctly as a family header for desktop too, but the 'mobile' suffix in the testid is misleading. Consider renaming or using distinct testids for desktop vs mobile headers (optional).

Minor: In testing some [data-testid^=palette-] elements are duplicated — the hidden desktop palette (palette-list parent) and the mobile palette both render same testids. Playwright strict locators pick the hidden copy first. Not user-visible but affects automated testing; consider suffixing mobile duplicates (e.g., palette-data_number-mobile).

critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate data-testid values for palette blocks across desktop (hidden on mobile) and mobile (hidden on desktop) palette strips cause strict-locator ambiguity. Suggest making testids unique or marking the hidden copy with aria-hidden/display:none so Playwright skips it.
testid name 'blocky-family-head-mobile' is also present on desktop viewport — rename to 'blocky-family-head' or split into desktop/mobile variants.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Builder page bug fixes (colored rail buttons, compact ideas dropdown replacing AI-speaking suggestion pills, mobile family head above CLICK TO ADD) all verified on mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x900 at https://circuit-mirror-2.preview.emergentagent.com/builder. When clicking mobile palette blocks via Playwright use JS click (page.evaluate) or filter visible elements — [data-testid^=palette-] matches both the hidden desktop list and the visible mobile strip, and strict locators pick the hidden one first. Compile flow (Ask Bolt submit) was NOT exercised (it was already covered in iteration_1 and the dropdown onChange only sets the sentence by design).
